prompt: Who was the head coach of the team that won the Superbowl the year that the show Law & Order: SVU was released?
answer: *Law & Order: Special Victims Unit* premiered in **1999**. The Super Bowl winner that year was the **Denver Broncos**, whose head coach was **Mike Shanahan**.
